Ernesto is fantastic. He has helped my dog ​​with her social skills, and now she's less afraid of walking in the street. I highly recommend him.

We're thrilled with Ernesto! He's completely trustworthy—super professional, punctual, flexible, and loving. Currito eagerly awaits his morning pick-up, leaving happy and returning super content after every walk 🐶💚
We love that he takes him for walks in nature and different parks around Madrid, where he socializes with other dogs and has a blast 🐾🌳
Ernesto always tells us where they're going, and it's clear he loves what he does and cares for the dogs as if they were his own.
Since he started going out with him, Currito feels more secure, is much more sociable, and very happy.

If you're looking for a responsible, loving, and animal-loving dog walker in Madrid, Ernesto is the best! 🙌✨

Ernesto is a fantastic professional and a wonderful person. I've been working with him for years, and my dog ​​is thrilled. He sends me photos and videos of his walks every day, and he even stays with him when I've had to travel. You can tell he loves dogs, and he does a fantastic job. I'm delighted, and my dog ​​even more so!

Ernesto is a wonderful person. He adapts to all needs and sent me photos of my dog ​​every time he took him for a walk. He's very dedicated and it's clear he loves what he does. I definitely recommend him if you want peace of mind knowing your dog is in good hands.

Excellent service, highly recommended. Kind and friendly service. I will definitely use their services again.

Great experience! My dog ​​enjoys every walk. The best part is that they keep me updated on the walk and how he behaves with other dogs. I highly recommend it.

100% recommended 👌 …
He has inspired a lot of confidence in me as a dog walker, very kind and punctual in his service.
My dog ​​has been there for a while now and it's clear they treat him very well; you can tell they have experience in pet care.
Excellent service, they send you directions to where they walked your dog and I love that, plus my dog ​​comes back tired and happy, they are very kind.
I am very happy with them, they are punctual with my dog's walk, which is a nice touch because it allows you to plan everything, and my dog ​​comes back happy after each walk.
My dog ​​was so content after a walk. My dog ​​is a chubby dachshund and sometimes it's hard to take her for a walk. It was a wonderful experience!
A very pleasant experience. The dog walker is always on time and treats the animals very well; you can tell he loves them very much. Very satisfied with everything.

Because we travel a lot, we had to leave our dog alone until someone came to look after him for a while each day, but since I found this service, he seems much happier. He doesn't suffer as much every time we leave.
Excellent service, our dog is always very happy when he sees Mateo. A very responsible and polite young man.
I really like how Mateo works; he's always on time to walk our dog. Our dog seems so happy since we started using his service. It's a great experience for both owners and dogs.

I'm sharing my experience so that other people and animals don't go through the same thing I did. The owner or employee was very nice upon arrival, but any questions or concerns you have afterward are met with rude and unpleasant responses. My dog ​​was greeted very politely, but upon returning, I witnessed some very inhumane behavior. When I asked for more affection, he responded with insults. I hope you can't afford to spend time with this person, even for an emergency.

I couldn't be more satisfied with the service provided by Ernesto and his team, with special thanks to José for taking such good care of Pepito during this time. They were incredibly professional, kind, and reliable. 100% recommended.

I was really looking forward to hiring the service, but I ended up being very disappointed. I was looking for a hybrid plan where my dog ​​could have daily walks and one or two longer walks to help him adjust, since he's older and has difficulty socializing with other dogs. Initially, the dog walker said it was no problem, but the next day, when I asked for confirmation, his attitude changed completely.

He accused me of trying to lower the price, assuming it was because I didn't have enough money, and made derogatory comments about it, when in reality we never discussed changing the rate, nor did I ask for a discount. When I asked him if I had done anything to upset him, he responded with offensive voice messages, and when I mentioned I would leave a review because of the poor treatment, he insulted me directly.

After this experience, I would never trust him with my dog. If he treated me like this, I don't want to imagine how he would treat the animals in his care.
I've been trusting Ernesto for months and he's never let me down! You can tell he has a special affection for each pet. Highly recommended so your best friend can also enjoy the outdoors!
A welcoming place and they pay close attention to every detail. I recommend them 100%. I will always use them; they are very professional.
Excellent service... their love for their best companions is unconditional... and they are very receptive to them... thank you for the attention provided.
I left my dog ​​with him during a trip I took to Madrid for a couple of days and I had a very good experience and felt very calm leaving him in his care.

At PASEOyouPERRO they take care of my furry friend like he's family! He always comes back happy and exhausted from playing. A friend saw him at the park and was amazed at how happy he was playing with other doggy friends! A 10 out of 10 for this team of animal lovers!
I'm not giving it 6 stars because there isn't enough space. Ernesto is constantly helping us with our dog and is always great.

Ernesto is pure magic with dogs. I had tried other sitters before, and none of them gave me that peace of mind. Nala is a dog with a strong personality, and he knows exactly how to handle her. I recommend her 100%. Thank you, Ernesto.

Excellent place to leave your pets. We went on a trip and our dog was always well cared for. Ernesto sent us videos and photos so we could see her; he took great care of her. We were very satisfied with the service and would definitely leave her with him again. We highly recommend this place.
Attentive and very responsible to the needs of each pet.
The care our dog Mara received was very satisfactory.
Everything was great with Ernesto. Very professional and punctual. He sends a tracking update of the walk and Bingo always left happy.
